Subject: Renewal inquiry — current on-call stack (contract exp 3/31/2026)

Hi team,

Our current contract with PagerPulse is up for renewal on 2026-03-31. We use the alerting + incident routing + public status pages across engineering and SRE. Before I loop procurement, can you confirm:

- Current line items and counts you have for account RDW-ENTERPRISE (we think: 120 seats, 18 escalation policies, 6 public status pages)
- Any new SKUs or mandatory add-ons for 2026 (e.g., increased retention, premium support tiers)
- List pricing and any available renewal discounts (we run a committed capacity / reserved bundle across multiple teams)

We may also evaluate a multi-year term with a PO. Please attach a renewal quote (PDF) and a sample SOW if there are integration or migration hours.

Thanks,
Monica

Monica — thanks for the ping. Quick notes from SRE: 

- We prefer a two-year term *only* if the vendor will guarantee current latency/ingestion SLAs and a migration path off the Incident Analytics add-on if it doesn't meet expectations. Otherwise stick to one year.
- 13 months retention is fine, but ensure logs export easily (we will ask for a SOC2 evidence that exports/s3 integration is available and reasonably priced).
- I'd like a technical review call with Elena (30m) to confirm the API limits and rate-limiting behavior under burst loads (we saw issues during the Feb 2025 incident).

If legal flags anything unusual we should table the two-year commit. We can get a PO in place with a clause to re-evaluate in 12 months.

Markus
Director, SRE
